Senior Financial Analyst FP&A, Amazon Leo Finance
Job ID: 10591861 | Amazon.com Services LLC
Apply now
Description
The LEO Infrastructure Finance team is seeking a Senior Financial Analyst to serve as a strategic finance partner to Production Operations, playing a critical role in shaping LEO's financial landscape. In this pivotal position, you will drive processes essential to Amazon's financial planning capabilities, partnering broadly across the Finance organization to translate complex data into compelling narratives and actionable insights that guide executive decision-making.
This role owns the strategy, governance, and oversight of LEO Infrastructure's end-to-end decision systems that underpin our financial reporting. You will partner with key business stakeholders to validate system inputs, identify opportunities for improvement, and propose strategies that elevate decision-making across the organization.
The successful candidate will be strategic, analytical, and able to work effectively with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced, global, results-oriented environment. The team needs a self-starter who can work efficiently and autonomously while managing complex multi-stakeholder coordination across highly ambiguous environments characterized by dynamic schedule changes, unpredictable demand forecasts, shifting political landscapes, and evolving international trade regulations.
Key job responsibilities
• Develop comprehensive financial bridges, narratives and strategic documents for executive leadership, covering monthly, quarterly, and annual planning processes
•Collaborate proactively with business finance teams using a customer-obsessed approach to ensure data accuracy and alignment of financial reporting
•Create guidance and workback plans to support key financial review meetings and processes
• Support process governance and improvement by implementing solutions using AI tools and automation technologies to enhance financial analysis and insights
• Utilize advanced financial systems to conduct deep-dive analyses and generate executive-level summaries
•Provide Monthly Financial Review content and participate in MBR discussions with senior leadership
•Drive continuous improvement, standardization, and automation throughout financial planning cycles
Basic Qualifications
- 3+ years of dissecting financial data and identifying patterns that support business strategy experience
- 3+ years of contributing to cross-functional initiatives that drive financial performance and strategy experience
- 3+ years of finance, accounting, or related analytical field experience
- Bachelor's degree in business, finance, accounting, tax, economics, or a related analytical field
- Experience with advanced use of SQL for data mining and business intelligence
- Can meet export control requirements by being a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum
- Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.
Preferred Qualifications
- 3+ years of building financial and operational reports/data sets that inform business decision-making experience
- 4+ years of participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results experience
- MBA, or CPA
- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)
